description: For every actual structure \(M\), relation clause \(C\), and ground substitution \(\sigma\), the actual clause formula is true at the term values \(\sigma(x)^M\) exactly when \(b_M\) satisfies the shared propositional ground clause \(C\sigma\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.grounded_clause_truth.{u, v, w, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  {M : Type z} [L.Structure M] (C : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.FOClause L α)
  (σ : α → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundTerm L) :
  ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseToFormula C).Realize fun x =>
      FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim (σ x)) ↔
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSat (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.modelValuation M)
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseSubst σ C)
